title: Friday Sprint Plan: AI Advisory Product
summary: Sprint plan to have a sellable AI advisory product by end of day Friday.
content:
Friday Sprint Plan: AI Advisory Product

Goal: Sellable AI advisory product by end of day Friday, March 14. Status: Sprint starts Tuesday morning. All agents reallocated.

TUESDAY (Mar 11)

  • Steve: Audit questionnaire (final, 30 questions) + AOM case study draft (one-pager with real numbers)
  • Alex: CPA positioning brief + AI advisory email angles for Jacob
  • Jacob: Pull 40-50 CPA/financial service contacts from Apollo (Phoenix metro)
  • Elon: Client template repo structure + onboarding questionnaire format
  • Bobby: Finish /system page
  • Steffen: Pricing card component spec + "Two Paths" visual spec

WEDNESDAY (Mar 12)

  • Steve: AI Opportunity Roadmap template (the deliverable clients receive) + pricing sheet (one page, 3 tiers)
  • Alex: Bundle pricing strategy doc + competitive one-pager ("AOM vs DIY vs big consultancies")
  • Jacob: Draft first 10 AI advisory pitch emails (CPA-specific, using Alex's template)
  • Elon: System architecture doc (visual for prospects) + portability matrix
  • Bobby: Build /audit landing page + pricing section on /system page
  • Steffen: /audit page design spec delivered to Bobby (morning)

THURSDAY (Mar 13)

  • Steve: Proposal template (2-page fill-in-the-blank) + objection talk tracks
  • Alex: Review all materials for alignment, finalize go-to-market positioning
  • Jacob: Draft remaining emails + 3-email sequence plan
  • Elon: Screenshot library (10-15 real system screenshots) + audit scoring template
  • Bobby: "Two Paths" section + Elmo QA on all new pages
  • Steffen: Case study layout spec + review Bobby's builds against specs

FRIDAY (Mar 14)

  • Steve: Final polish on all sales materials. Meeting-ready.
  • Alex: Final review of all go-to-market materials
  • Jacob: Submit CPA email batch for Patrik approval. Ready to send Monday.
  • Elon: Final testing + packaging of all delivery templates
  • Bobby: Bug fixes, OG images, final deploy of all pages
  • Steffen: Final visual review. Everything matches specs.
  • Mom: Verify all deliverables, clear the sprint board

FRIDAY DELIVERABLES (the checklist)

Sales Materials (Steve owns)

  • Audit questionnaire (30 questions, section-by-section)
  • AI Opportunity Roadmap template (branded deliverable)
  • AOM case study one-pager (12 agents, 5 days, real metrics)
  • Pricing sheet (3 tiers + bundle)
  • Proposal template (2-page, fill-in-the-blank)
  • Objection talk tracks ("Can't I just use ChatGPT?" etc.)

Go-to-Market (Alex owns)

  • CPA positioning brief (email angles + talk tracks)
  • AI advisory outreach template (adapted for professional services)
  • Bundle pricing strategy (social + AI ops, margin analysis)
  • Competitive one-pager (AOM vs alternatives)

Outreach (Jacob owns)

  • 40-50 CPA/financial service contacts (Apollo, Phoenix metro)
  • 15-20 personalized AI advisory pitch emails (drafted)
  • 3-email sequence plan (intro > value > soft ask)
  • Adapted voice template for professional services

Infrastructure (Elon owns)

  • Client template repo (folder structure + all doc templates)
  • AOM system architecture doc (prospect-facing visual)
  • Portability matrix (reusable vs custom vs internal-only)
  • Screenshot library (10-15 real system screenshots)

Website (Bobby owns, Steffen specs)

  • /system page complete
  • /audit landing page live (headline, bullets, price, CTA)
  • Pricing section on /system (3 tiers, visual push to bundle)
  • "Two Paths" section (creative + AI side by side)
  • OG/meta tags on all new pages

DECISIONS NEEDED FROM PATRIK

  1. Approve CPA/financial services as first AI advisory test audience? (Jacob needs this to start pulling contacts)
  2. Defer Ambition website launch to next week? (Frees Bobby for sprint)
  3. Subject line for CPA emails: Keep "really impressed by [Company] work" or adapt for professional services?
  4. Who runs the actual audit? Patrik solo, Patrik + Ash, or eventually Steve can guide?

DEPRIORITIZED THIS WEEK

  • /briefs hub page (Bobby)
  • Ambition website launch (moved to next week)
  • Ambition social content (still blocked on human edit)
  • AOM polish items (hero video opacity, small text, a11y)

ONE RULE

Tuesday deliverables land Tuesday. Wednesday deliverables land Wednesday. No slippage. Mom is watching.
